general.summary: Compare health with damage: a mob kills an unarmoured player at full health (20) in ceil(20 / damage) hits. Nothing on this pack scales mob damage: the difficulty is normal (vanilla scales mob damage to players only on easy and hard), Scaling Health adds no damage (Damage Modifier 0, Difficulty Weight 0, no mob potions, difficulty stays 0), Epic Siege Mod adds none (Boss Kill Modifier 0), Damage Control keeps the 'mob' source at 1.0 (but cuts what players deal, 'player' and 'arrow', to 0.8: the bot's own hits do 80%), Thicc Entities scales none of these mobs, and Rough Mobs changes ATTACK_DAMAGE only for the mobs it lists (blaze, dread lich, weta among these). A held weapon adds its attack damage (zombies get one 1 time in 5).
